# `get_img_file_page_number`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Count the pages of the image file listing for a directory.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xe5f20, GetImgFilePageNum @0x130b20, FillPath @0x6e0860, bool_param @0x6f58f0 (64-bit build) |

Rebuilds the device's sorted image list for the given directory synchronously and returns ceil(entries / page_num) as a bare integer. The call replaces the shared list parameters and sorted list, so a later get_img_file_page_name continues from this listing; it is the catalog's established mutating getter. No entries, totals or paths are returned. The enumeration result is not checked, so a count does not prove that storage access succeeded.

Side effects: Overwrites the shared image-list parameters and rebuilds the sorted image list cache; no persistent setting or device operation.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_img_file_page_number"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|array | no | - | Optional. Absent params use all defaults. An object may carry dir, page_num, size, date and skip_avi (wrong-typed members are ignored, leaving defaults, except page_num which must be positive). An array supplies only the directory: its first element, a string, is used as the directory path; an empty array uses defaults; a non-string first element gives 105; further elements are ignored. Explicit params of any other JSON type, including null, give 102. A path the device recognises is kept, otherwise it is prefixed with the image storage root. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | Array params whose first element is not a string | `expected string param` |
| 209 | Effective page_num is not positive | `invalid value` |
| 102 | Explicit params present but neither an object nor an array (including null) | `invalid params` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

Behaviour when filesystem enumeration fails is unresolved. The object key for the directory (dir) comes from the per-method reference; an older catalog row names the key path, which only the array form uses.

## Example

Request, defaults:

```json
{"id":80,"method":"get_img_file_page_number"}
```

Request, with-options - Values invented:

```json
{"id":81,"method":"get_img_file_page_number","params":{"dir":"MyWorks","page_num":20,"size":true,"date":true,"skip_avi":false}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_img_file_page_number","result":3,"code":0,"id":80}
```

Reply, bad-page-size:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_img_file_page_number","error":"invalid value","code":209,"id":82}
```
